pr.title: gh-140939: Fix memory leak in `_PyBytes_FormatEx` error path
pr.body:
It is already accounted for in the other path:

https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/b373d3494c587cf27b31f3dff89a8d96f7d29b9d/Objects/bytesobject.c#L1049-L1054

<!-- gh-issue-number: gh-140939 -->
* Issue: gh-140939
<!-- /gh-issue-number -->

labels.name: type-bug
labels.description: An unexpected behavior, bug, or error

files.patch:
@@ -802,6 +802,13 @@ def __int__(self):
             with self.assertRaisesRegex(TypeError, msg):
                 operator.mod(format_bytes, value)
 
+    def test_memory_leak_gh_140939(self):
+        # gh-140939: MemoryError is raised without leaking
+        _testcapi = import_helper.import_module('_testcapi')
+        with self.assertRaises(MemoryError):
+            b = self.type2test(b'%*b')
+            b % (_testcapi.PY_SSIZE_T_MAX, b'abc')
+
     def test_imod(self):
         b = self.type2test(b'hello, %b!')
         orig = b

@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@
+Fix memory leak when :class:`bytearray` or :class:`bytes` is formated with the
+``%*b`` format with a large width that results in a :exc:`MemoryError`.

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -802,6 +802,12 @@ def __int__(self):
             with self.assertRaisesRegex(TypeError, msg):
                 operator.mod(format_bytes, value)
 
+        # gh-140939: MemoryError is raised without leaking
+        for _ in range(100):
review_comments.body:
Please remove the loop. It's not needed to detect the leak.

Example without the fix and without the loop:

```
test_bytes leaked [2, 2, 2] references, sum=6
```

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -802,6 +802,12 @@ def __int__(self):
             with self.assertRaisesRegex(TypeError, msg):
                 operator.mod(format_bytes, value)
 
+        # gh-140939: MemoryError is raised without leaking
+        for _ in range(100):
+            with self.assertRaises((MemoryError, OverflowError)):
+                b = self.type2test(b'%*b')
+                b % (2**63-1, b'abc')
review_comments.body: You should replace `2**63-1` with `_testcapi.PY_SSIZE_T_MAX` for 32-bit platforms.

review_comments.diff_hunk:
@@ -802,6 +802,12 @@ def __int__(self):
             with self.assertRaisesRegex(TypeError, msg):
                 operator.mod(format_bytes, value)
 
+        # gh-140939: MemoryError is raised without leaking
review_comments.body: Please move this code into a new test, since `import_helper.import_module()` can skip the test if the module is missing.
